entities.summary: Alberto Mondi is an Italian who lives and performs in South Korea as a television personality and businessman. He is currently a cast member in the talk show Non-Summit. He is a former footballer in Serie D. Alberto Mondi was a performers & entertainers from Mirano (b. 1984-01-17, Mirano). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
